comparison_notes.tag: Per-election results all match, and my rule-based tag UNKNOWN equals the research record's owner_override.rule_tag UNKNOWN. The research final tag LIVE_PRECINCT (confidence med) is an owner override (decided 2026-10-02T20:08:31Z, based on Nov 2024 and the owner's statement about November 2026), which I was told not to verify. agree=true refers to the per-election results and rule tag.
